title: Matrices list shows each matrix's status, categories, tiers and both sides
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, category A.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix B, which prices no category.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Point at matrix B's Inactive status.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The list has the columns Matrix, Status, Categories, Tiers, Work Order Matrix and Part Sale Matrix.
  • Matrix A's Status reads Active and its Categories cell names category A.
  • Matrix A's Work Order Matrix shows Default's rules in short words.
  • Matrix A's Part Sale Matrix reads "Same as work orders" (it has no separate Part Sale pricing).
  • Matrix B's Status reads Inactive.

Step 2:

  • A tooltip reads "No categories use this matrix".
